newsitem.title: UK: UK's Labour pours scorn on jobless figures.
newsitem.headline: UK's Labour pours scorn on jobless figures.

text.p: The opposition Labour party on Wednesday poured scorn on the latest unemployment figures showing a sharp fall. Labour's deputy leader John Prescott said in a statement: "More people believe in Santa Claus."
Prescott accused the government of having fiddled the figures to bring the unemployment total below two million.
"The problem is no one believes their bogus figures. Much of the drop in the figures can only be explained by people being driven off the register and off the record altogether," he said.

Labour's chief employment spokesman, Ian McCartney, added: These unbelievable figures are the result of chaos caused by the Jobseekers Allowance. These figures are pure fantasy and the public know it." -- London Newsroom +44-171-542-7768
